answer: Require each agent to lock a bonded escrow deposit before it can transact. A sybil swarm must then fund one deposit per fake identity, so minting a thousand clones costs a thousand bonds, not one. Honest peers audit behavior, and any agent whose pulse of activity matches kin-clustering is slashed, forfeiting its deposit. Like staining cells with pigment to reveal hidden structure, attestation exposes the sybil graph, so a clean long-lived identity becomes a pearl too costly to fake at scale.
